name: Screen To Sheet
description: Built for online tutors, this workspace transforms uploaded photos of handwritten notes and marked exam papers into clean, structured cards. It preserves the student's working 100% verbatim alongside color-coded teacher feedback, adds diagnostic error tags and step-by-step model solutions, and includes live screen-sharing toggles (Hide/Reveal Answers, Blank Retake Mode, and editable lesson notes) with one-click A4 PDF printing.
